name: fanout
description: Post once, fan out to every connected social account.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@fanout/core-posting && npm run build --workspace=@fanout/token-exchange
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@fanout/core-posting && npm run test --workspace=@fanout/token-exchange
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@fanout/core-posting && npm run typecheck --workspace=@fanout/token-exchange && npm run typecheck --workspace=app
